image_prompt: Masterpiece antique Victorian steel engraving and fine copperplate etching bookplate illustration in the deluxe 19th-century style of illustrated Longfellow editions. A dramatic nocturnal panorama across Boston Harbor: on the dark foreground Charlestown shore, Paul Revere stands alert in colonial tricorn hat, billowing cloak, and boots, holding the bridle of his spirited steed; across the moonlit tidal river, the high spire of the Old North Church rises with two brilliant signal lanterns burning in the belfry arch, casting twin shimmering reflections across the water.
caption: Watching from the Charlestown shore: Paul Revere and his spirited steed gazing across the dark tide toward the twin gleaming lanterns in the belfry tower.
